title: Completed adic slice ordinary and derived scalar extension
statement: For a scheme X, an object U of its small pro-etale site and a map f:R -> S of sheaves of commutative rings, the slice scalar-extension data is the universal ordinary and derived scalar-extension witness [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] for the restricted coefficient map f|U on the localized ringed site [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], with standard derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. The ordinary slice scalar extension is its chosen ordinary functor (sheafified tensor on objects and maps) and the derived slice scalar extension is its chosen total left derived functor.
